column1: ! emily-modifiers. Every layer by its whole table rather than by a sample: the
! 39 keysym rows in all four variants, all 29 fingerspelling chords against all
! 32 modifier combinations, every one of the 128 payload chords as a number, and
! all 256 literal numbers. The expectations were emily-modifiers.py's own
! answers, taken while that dictionary was still the definition, with the skhd
! branch emptied because a binding is a fact about a machine. This grammar is the
! definition now, so the file is the expectation and there is nothing to
! A line with no expectation asserts there is no entry.
! `#` is phrasing's, so the Python's 16 bit on a digit or an F-key and its 256
! bit on a literal number have no entry here.
! keysyms: every row, every variant, bare and with modifiers
! -Z is the same marker as the star, including both at once
! numbers and F-keys: every payload chord
! a digit or an F-key with modifiers held
! literal numbers: all 256, the payload as binary
! modifiers have nothing to modify on a literal number
! fingerspelling: every chord against every modifier combination
! the literal keys are inert on a letter
! no payload, no entry: `^` is the 128 bit and nothing else
! `@EU` plus a payload is the reserved command namespace
